content.text:
Cannot execute multiple commands at once.
Please run each command separately OR chain them into a single command via && or ;
Provided commands:
(1) cd /workspace && node services/api-server.cjs > /tmp/api-server.log 2>&1 &
(2) sleep 3
(3) curl -s http://localhost:8080/health 2>/dev/null | head -c 500 || echo "Server not responding"
